t: This is St John's Church, Waterloo, an Anglican church in the Greek Revival style, built between 1822 and 1824. It's dedicated to St John the Evangelist, and it forms a united benefice with St Andrew's in Short Street. The architect was Francis Octavius Bedford, an English ecclesiastical architect who designed four Greek Revival churches in south London during the 1820s. This is one of them. Later in his career he turned to the Gothic style.
